diagnosis_candidates.description: The configuration file `application-dev.yml` incorrectly specifies `on-profile: staging` under `spring.config.activate`. Because the active profile is `dev`, the properties in this file are not applied, causing the application to fall back to the default endpoint defined in `application.yml`.
diagnosis_candidates.recommended_fix: Update the `on-profile` value in `application-dev.yml` to `dev`, or remove the `spring.config.activate` block entirely since the file name already associates it with the `dev` profile.
diagnosis_candidates.title: Incorrect profile activation condition in application-dev.yml

diagnosis_evidence.summary: The application falls back to the default shipping endpoint because `application-dev.yml` incorrectly specifies `on-profile: staging`. When the `dev` profile is active, the properties in this file are ignored, causing the fallback endpoint from `application.yml` to be used.

root_cause_summary: The application falls back to the default shipping endpoint because `application-dev.yml` incorrectly specifies `on-profile: staging`. When the `dev` profile is active, the properties in this file are ignored, causing the fallback endpoint from `application.yml` to be used.
